meals.name: Sheet Pan Lemon Herb Chicken & Roasted Potatoes
meals.description: Tender chicken and crispy potatoes roasted with lemon and herbs, ready in about 40 minutes.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a large sheet pan with parchment paper.

Cut potatoes into 1-inch pieces. Mince garlic. In a large bowl, toss potatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil, half the minced garlic, 1/2 tsp oregano, 1/2 tsp paprika, salt, and pepper. Spread on half of the sheet pan.

Slice chicken breasts into 1-inch thick strips. In the same bowl, toss chicken with remaining 1 tbsp olive oil, remaining garlic, 1/2 tsp oregano, 1/2 tsp paprika, juice of 1/2 lemon, salt, and pepper. Spread on the other half of the sheet pan.

Roast for 20-25 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through (internal temperature 165°F / 74°C) and potatoes are tender and lightly browned. Squeeze remaining 1/2 lemon over the chicken and potatoes. Garnish with fresh parsley if desired before serving.

meals.name: Speedy Ground Beef Tacos
meals.description: Flavorful ground beef tacos with classic toppings, ready in under 25 minutes for a quick weeknight meal.
instructions: Brown ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart with a spoon, until no pink remains, about 5-7 minutes. Drain any excess fat.
Stir in the taco seasoning mix and 1/2 cup water. Bring to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens.
Warm taco shells or tortillas according to package directions.
Assemble tacos by spooning the seasoned ground beef into shells/tortillas and topping with shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, shredded cheddar cheese, and a dollop of sour cream.

meals.name: Slow Cooker BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches
meals.description: Tender, slow-cooked pulled pork coated in sweet and tangy BBQ sauce, perfect for sandwiches, ready in 6-8 hours.
instructions: Trim any large excess fat from the pork shoulder. Rub the pork with garlic powder and paprika.
Dice the yellow onion and place it in the bottom of a 6-quart or larger slow cooker. Place the seasoned pork shoulder on top of the onions.
In a bowl, whisk together BBQ sauce, brown sugar, apple cider vinegar, and chicken broth. Pour over the pork.

Cook on low for 6-8 hours or on high for 3-4 hours, until the pork is very tender and easily shreds with a fork. Remove pork from the slow cooker, shred it using two forks, then return to the sauce in the slow cooker and stir to combine. Serve warm on hamburger buns, optionally topped with coleslaw.

meals.name: Teriyaki Beef & Broccoli Bowls
meals.description: Quick and flavorful beef and broccoli stir-fry in a savory teriyaki sauce, served over rice, ready in about 35 minutes.
instructions: Cook white rice according to package directions. Thinly slice flank steak against the grain into bite-sized strips. Mince garlic and grate ginger.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, sesame oil, minced garlic, grated ginger, and cornstarch. Set aside.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add beef strips and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until browned. Remove beef from the skillet and set aside.

Add broccoli florets to the skillet and stir-fry for 5-7 minutes until tender-crisp. Return beef to the skillet. Pour the prepared teriyaki sauce over the beef and broccoli, stir constantly for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens and coats everything. Serve immediately over cooked rice, garnished with sesame seeds if desired.

meals.name: Crispy Baked Chicken Drumsticks with Roasted Green Beans
meals.description: Oven-baked chicken drumsticks with a crispy coating and tender roasted green beans, a kid-favorite, ready in about 45 minutes.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a large baking sheet with foil or parchment paper and place a wire rack on top (optional, for crispier chicken).

In a shallow dish, combine panko breadcrumbs, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, and dried thyme. Drizzle drumsticks with 1 tbsp olive oil, then dredge each drumstick in the breadcrumb mixture, pressing to coat thoroughly. Place on the prepared wire rack/baking sheet.
In a bowl, toss green beans with remaining 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper. Spread green beans on the other half of the baking sheet or a second small baking sheet.

Bake chicken for 30-35 minutes, flipping halfway, until internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C) and the coating is golden and crispy. Roast green beans alongside for 15-20 minutes, until tender-crisp and slightly charred. Serve hot.

meals.name: Skillet Shrimp Scampi with Linguine
meals.description: Garlicky shrimp cooked in a buttery lemon-wine sauce tossed with linguine, a quick and elegant meal ready in about 35 minutes.
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions in a large pot of salted water. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water before draining.
While pasta cooks, mince garlic. Zest and juice the lemon. Pat shrimp dry.
In a large skillet, melt butter with olive oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and red pepper flakes; cook for 1 minute until fragrant (do not brown garlic).
Add shrimp to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and opaque. Pour in white wine and lemon juice; bring to a simmer and cook for 1-2 minutes until slightly reduced.

Add cooked and drained linguine, chopped fresh parsley, and reserved pasta water (if needed for desired consistency) to the skillet. Toss everything to combine and coat the pasta. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve immediately.

meals.name: Sheet Pan Italian Sausage & Pepper Hoagies
meals.description: Flavorful Italian sausage, bell peppers, and onions roasted on a sheet pan, served in toasted hoagie rolls with melty provolone cheese, ready in about 50 minutes.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a large sheet pan with parchment paper.
Slice bell peppers and onion into 1/2-inch strips. In a large bowl, toss peppers and onions with olive oil, garlic powder, dried oregano, salt, and pepper. Spread evenly on the sheet pan.
Add Italian sausage links to the sheet pan, nestled among the vegetables.
Roast for 30-35 minutes, turning the sausages and vegetables halfway, until sausages are cooked through (internal temperature 160°F / 71°C) and vegetables are tender and slightly caramelized.

Slice hoagie rolls lengthwise, place them cut-side up on a separate smaller baking sheet. Top each roll with 1-2 slices of provolone cheese. Place in the oven for the last 5 minutes of cooking, or until cheese is melted and rolls are lightly toasted. Assemble hoagies by placing sausages and vegetables into the toasted rolls with melted provolone. Garnish with fresh parsley if desired. Serve with marinara sauce for dipping.
